title: Chapter 533
text:
After leaving Blue Star, Han Xiao asked Wilsander about the current location of Floating Dragon Island. During this time, Floating Dragon Island had drifted to the Rain Star System. He had piloted the BlackLight Stealth alone, and the main reason for this trip was to put on an act. Before he left, he had wanted to inform Nagakin, but he had not seen the other party, and Nagakin had not taken the initiative to ask about this matter. After pondering for a while, Han Xiao decided not to reveal the matter. As such, he did not contact Nagakin from afar for the time being, and he had the time to think about what conditions he should raise with Godora.Furthermore, he also wanted to see for himself the impact Dark-star had on the Garton Star System. In the storyline of his previous life, he was also a player on the surface, and he only learned about the specific process after the incident. He did not personally experience the changes in the galactic environment. Now that he had the chance to see it with his own eyes, he naturally wanted to open his eyes wide and see it clearly. Han Technician was still very curious about the unknown storyline.The Black Star Mercenary had taken on a few missions in the Rain Star System before, so Han Xiao was familiar with the route. The itinerary was very simple. He first went to Juberly Hub to replenish his fuel, then quickly jumped to the Rain Star System through the stargate. After that, he went to Floating Dragon Island directly. With the speed of the BlackLight Stealth, the round trip would take less than half a month.Blue Star did not need him to be there for the time being. After all, Godora's Military Orbital Hyperdrive Base Station was not for decoration. If Dark-star wanted to attack, it would only attack the other colonial planets of Godora.The matters of the mercenary group were thrown to Herlous. Herlous was the officer who joined the mercenary group the earliest, and he was also the captain of the Sunil Division. When Han Xiao was in seclusion building machinery or slacking off, Herlous had always been in charge of the mercenary group's affairs. He was conscientious and was a competent assistant. Han Xiao had always adhered to the principle of 'if there's anything, the secretary will do it'.The BlackLight Stealth jumped through the stargate of Star Zone 9 at high speed and flew out from one of the many stargates around Juberly Hub. Without any passengers in the way, he had a great time driving the ship.In the cockpit, Han Xiao glanced at the 3D star map."Right, Planet Golden Gate is nearby. Let's make a trip there and check on the condition of Base No.1. It won't take long anyway."The spaceship turned around and arrived at Planet Golden Gate not long after. Through the window, they could see that the current situation on Planet Golden Gate was very different from before. A large number of Godora fleets were surrounding Planet Golden Gate, and their security was extremely tight.Han Xiao raised his eyebrows and thought to himself, "That's right, Dark-star's attack on Long Arc Constellation has caused a huge impact, causing Godora to feel threatened. All of the colonial planets' fleets are patrolling and defending around the clock. It can be said that they are in a state of panic."Planet Golden Gate's Freedom Pier was also sealed off by the military, and one had to undergo a strict identity check before landing. This was the threat posed by Ashes. The strength that he had displayed made Godora extremely cautious, and they did not dare to allow Dark-star's people to slip onto the surface.There was a long queue of spaceships entering and leaving the planet. Han Xiao's identity was successfully checked, but he did not receive any special treatment at this time. He had to queue for a period of time before landing at the pier.Walking on the streets, Han Xiao realized that the atmosphere of the city was completely different. In the past, it was bustling with noise and liveliness, but now, there were not many people on the streets, and the atmosphere was extremely tense. Even if there were passersby, they were all silent and seemed to have a lot on their minds.The most common people on the streets were Godora's patrolling soldiers. They had serious expressions on their faces, and their footsteps were uniform. Han Xiao really wanted to go up and trip them.The changes on Planet Golden Gate were due to the terror caused by Dark-star. Although another colonial planet had been attacked, the people from other planets did not know if they would be the next target. Everyone felt that it was very dangerous to stay on a colonial planet. Thus, they decided to take intergalactic travel groups and wander around the universe to avoid the limelight.However, due to the conflict between Godora and Dark-star, the security of the Garton Star System had deteriorated rapidly, and the risk of traveling was much greater than before.Many wanderers and space pirates felt that this was an opportunity and felt that Godora did not have the energy to deal with them. Thus, they all came to the Garton Star System. Now, there was a large number of villains running amok in the Garton Star System. Many Godora people who had escaped were robbed or kidnapped, and this caused the security of Godora to be in a terrible situation.Over the past few days, Han Xiao had received thousands of employment offers from the Mercenary Alliance. They were all about galactic pirates wreaking havoc in the various star zones of the Garton Star System. It could be seen that the situation was extremely bad, and it had become a carnival for galactic pirates.Dark-star's influence could be said to be a chain reaction. Dark-star did not join forces with these galactic pirates. Galactic pirates and wanderers were villains who took advantage of loopholes. Now that Dark-star had exposed a loophole in Godora, there would naturally be people who would take advantage of the situation. Han Xiao could also understand this situation. After all, Godora was now in shambles, and the galactic pirates naturally felt that it would be a waste not to come."The situation is really bad." Han Xiao shook his head and thought to himself.When he returned to Black Star Base No.1, everything was normal.He checked the progress of the military factory's assembly line. Although he was in Blue Star, the assembly line had never stopped working. The program was controlled by Philip, and he could remotely control the assembly line while he was in Blue Star.The machinery and equipment created by the assembly line were piled up into a small mountain in the warehouse. Han Xiao counted the quantity, and it was enough to sell to two to three hundred thousand players. These were the goods that he had hoarded, and he was only waiting to guide the players into space. At that time, the only problem was that he might run out of stock.After adding a new batch of materials to the assembly line to maintain the production, Han Xiao did not stay any longer. He left Planet Golden Gate and headed to Juberly Hub.The Blacklight Stealth entered the dock of the hub and slowly docked in the boathouse. He needed to replenish a batch of fuel, and he had to bring a portion back to Blue Star to replenish the fuel for the other spaceships.After he was done with his purchases, he could set off.Juberly Hub was still bustling with activity, as though it was not affected by Dark-star at all. Han Xiao walked to the main hall of the hub and walked out of the entrance. After determining the direction, he walked toward the store area.At the same time, a few people in the distance recognized Han Xiao. These people were wearing simple combat suits, which were very common in Juberly Hub. Thus, they did not attract much attention.These people were in a group, and they stared at Han Xiao's back as he walked away. They exchanged glances and whispered to each other."Is that Black Star?""That's right, it's him!""Hehe, who would have thought that we would actually find such a big fish when we were just here to replenish our supplies.""Quickly inform the boss."In a bar in the main hall of the hub, this was a bar that was not very high class and was located in a rather remote location.The group of people who had discovered Han Xiao earlier hurried over. They looked around and quickly came to a seat in the corner of the bar. A burly human was sitting there in a heavy combat suit. He was drinking hard liquor, and the liquor flowed down from the corner of his mouth, wetting his beard that was like a lion's mane."Boss Befuli, we've discovered an enemy!"Befuli, who was called the boss, put down his glass heavily, and the liquor splashed out along the rim of the glass. His upper body leaned forward, and a rough face appeared in the dim light of the bar. According to the aesthetics of normal people in the universe, this face was worthy of the title of 'unrestrained'.His eyes did not have any white, and they were completely red like flowing flames. His eyeballs were white, and he looked very ferocious, like someone with red eye cataracts.'Red Flame Eyes' Befuli, a ferocious galactic pirate active in the Fawn Star System. He was a Grade B Super and belonged to the infamous galactic pirate organization, the Purple Snake Galactic Pirate Gang.The Purple Snake Galactic Pirate Gang had dozens of plundering spaceships, and their captain was a Calamity Grade Super. The Black Raven Civilization had put a bounty of 2,800,000 Enas on him. Han Xiao had once been stuck on the Promotion Mission of killing a Grade Super, and the captain of the Purple Snake Galactic Pirate Gang was one of the targets he had considered. Later on, he had drawn a Mission Completion Card, so he did not take the risk.More than two years ago, Han Xiao had brought Mad Blade and the other players to do missions, and they had once killed an officer of the Purple Snake Galactic Pirate Gang. At that time, they had formed a grudge. As a mercenary, it was inevitable to have enemies, and Han Xiao had long been used to it.Befuli was an officer of the Purple Snake Galactic Pirate Gang. He led a team and came to the Garton Star System to plunder while Godora was facing both external and internal problems. At this time, the team he led was hiding their identities and resting in Juberly Hub. In the past, they had mainly been active in the Fawn Star System, so it was easy to disguise themselves in the Garton Star System."Enemy?Who?! ""It's Black Star!""So, it's him."Befuli laughed with a sinister expression. "A few years ago, he killed Mado's team in the Fawn Star System. Heh, although I don't like Mado, this debt is something that the captain has always remembered.""Boss, Black Star is only one person. Should we make a move on him?"A galactic pirate asked softly with a murderous look in his eyes.Befuli heard this and laughed boorishly. "Hahaha, do you think that Black Star is so easy to kill?Are you courting death?! "As he spoke, Befuli's face suddenly changed. He grabbed his subordinate's neck and pulled him to his eyes. He said in a ferocious voice, "Brat, you don't have the qualifications to covet someone of that level. You better respect the strong!"This galactic pirate swallowed a mouthful of saliva nervously and nodded. Boss Befuli's temper was unpredictable, and he did not dare to anger him.Befuli let go of his hand, grabbed the wine glass, and finished the rest of the liquor in one gulp. He wiped his mouth, stood up, and walked toward the door with large strides."Little ones, follow me."The few galactic pirates behind him hurriedly followed behind Befuli and asked carefully, "Boss, what are we going to do now?" Before he left, he had wanted to inform Nagakin, but he had not seen the other party, and Nagakin had not taken the initiative to ask about this matter. After pondering for a while, Han Xiao decided not to reveal the matter. As such, he did not contact Nagakin from afar for the time being, and he had the time to think about what conditions he should raise with Godora.

Furthermore, he also wanted to see for himself the impact Dark-star had on the Garton Star System. He did not personally experience the changes in the galactic environment. Now that he had the chance to see it with his own eyes, he naturally wanted to open his eyes wide and see it clearly. The Black Star Mercenary had taken on a few missions in the Rain Star System before, so Han Xiao was familiar with the route. The itinerary was very simple. He first went to Juberly Hub to replenish his fuel, then quickly jumped to the Rain Star System through the stargate. After that, he went to Floating Dragon Island directly. With the speed of the BlackLight Stealth, the round trip would take less than half a month.

Blue Star did not need him to be there for the time being. After all, Godora's Military Orbital Hyperdrive Base Station was not for decoration. If Dark-star wanted to attack, it would only attack the other colonial planets of Godora.

The matters of the mercenary group were thrown to Herlous. Herlous was the officer who joined the mercenary group the earliest, and he was also the captain of the Sunil Division. Han Xiao had always adhered to the principle of 'if there's anything, the secretary will do it'.

The BlackLight Stealth jumped through the stargate of Star Zone 9 at high speed and flew out from one of the many stargates around Juberly Hub. Without any passengers in the way, he had a great time driving the ship.

In the cockpit, Han Xiao glanced at the 3D star map.

"Right, Planet Golden Gate is nearby. Let's make a trip there and check on the condition of Base No.1. It won't take long anyway."

The spaceship turned around and arrived at Planet Golden Gate not long after. Through the window, they could see that the current situation on Planet Golden Gate was very different from before. A large number of Godora fleets were surrounding Planet Golden Gate, and their security was extremely tight.

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows and thought to himself, "That's right, Dark-star's attack on Long Arc Constellation has caused a huge impact, causing Godora to feel threatened. All of the colonial planets' fleets are patrolling and defending around the clock. It can be said that they are in a state of panic."

Planet Golden Gate's Freedom Pier was also sealed off by the military, and one had to undergo a strict identity check before landing. This was the threat posed by Ashes. The strength that he had displayed made Godora extremely cautious, and they did not dare to allow Dark-star's people to slip onto the surface.

There was a long queue of spaceships entering and leaving the planet. Han Xiao's identity was successfully checked, but he did not receive any special treatment at this time. He had to queue for a period of time before landing at the pier.

Walking on the streets, Han Xiao realized that the atmosphere of the city was completely different. In the past, it was bustling with noise and liveliness, but now, there were not many people on the streets, and the atmosphere was extremely tense. Even if there were passersby, they were all silent and seemed to have a lot on their minds.

The most common people on the streets were Godora's patrolling soldiers. They had serious expressions on their faces, and their footsteps were uniform. Han Xiao really wanted to go up and trip them.

The changes on Planet Golden Gate were due to the terror caused by Dark-star. Although another colonial planet had been attacked, the people from other planets did not know if they would be the next target. Everyone felt that it was very dangerous to stay on a colonial planet. Thus, they decided to take intergalactic travel groups and wander around the universe to avoid the limelight.

However, due to the conflict between Godora and Dark-star, the security of the Garton Star System had deteriorated rapidly, and the risk of traveling was much greater than before.

Many wanderers and space pirates felt that this was an opportunity and felt that Godora did not have the energy to deal with them. Thus, they all came to the Garton Star System. Now, there was a large number of villains running amok in the Garton Star System. Many Godora people who had escaped were robbed or kidnapped, and this caused the security of Godora to be in a terrible situation.

Over the past few days, Han Xiao had received thousands of employment offers from the Mercenary Alliance. They were all about galactic pirates wreaking havoc in the various star zones of the Garton Star System. It could be seen that the situation was extremely bad, and it had become a carnival for galactic pirates.

Dark-star's influence could be said to be a chain reaction. Dark-star did not join forces with these galactic pirates. Galactic pirates and wanderers were villains who took advantage of loopholes. Now that Dark-star had exposed a loophole in Godora, there would naturally be people who would take advantage of the situation. Han Xiao could also understand this situation. After all, Godora was now in shambles, and the galactic pirates naturally felt that it would be a waste not to come.

"The situation is really bad." Han Xiao shook his head and thought to himself.

When he returned to Black Star Base No.1, everything was normal. He checked the progress of the military factory's assembly line. Although he was in Blue Star, the assembly line had never stopped working. The program was controlled by Philip, and he could remotely control the assembly line while he was in Blue Star.

The machinery and equipment created by the assembly line were piled up into a small mountain in the warehouse. Han Xiao counted the quantity, and it was enough to sell to two to three hundred thousand players. These were the goods that he had hoarded, and he was only waiting to guide the players into space. At that time, the only problem was that he might run out of stock.

After adding a new batch of materials to the assembly line to maintain the production, Han Xiao did not stay any longer. He left Planet Golden Gate and headed to Juberly Hub.

The Blacklight Stealth entered the dock of the hub and slowly docked in the boathouse. He needed to replenish a batch of fuel, and he had to bring a portion back to Blue Star to replenish the fuel for the other spaceships.

After he was done with his purchases, he could set off.

Juberly Hub was still bustling with activity, as though it was not affected by Dark-star at all. Han Xiao walked to the main hall of the hub and walked out of the entrance. After determining the direction, he walked toward the store area.

At the same time, a few people in the distance recognized Han Xiao. These people were wearing simple combat suits, which were very common in Juberly Hub. Thus, they did not attract much attention.

These people were in a group, and they stared at Han Xiao's back as he walked away. They exchanged glances and whispered to each other.

"Is that Black Star?"

"That's right, it's him!"

"Hehe, who would have thought that we would actually find such a big fish when we were just here to replenish our supplies."

"Quickly inform the boss."

In a bar in the main hall of the hub, this was a bar that was not very high class and was located in a rather remote location.

The group of people who had discovered Han Xiao earlier hurried over. They looked around and quickly came to a seat in the corner of the bar. A burly human was sitting there in a heavy combat suit. He was drinking hard liquor, and the liquor flowed down from the corner of his mouth, wetting his beard that was like a lion's mane.

"Boss Befuli, we've discovered an enemy!"

Befuli, who was called the boss, put down his glass heavily, and the liquor splashed out along the rim of the glass. His upper body leaned forward, and a rough face appeared in the dim light of the bar. According to the aesthetics of normal people in the universe, this face was worthy of the title of 'unrestrained'.

His eyes did not have any white, and they were completely red like flowing flames. His eyeballs were white, and he looked very ferocious, like someone with red eye cataracts.

'Red Flame Eyes' Befuli, a ferocious galactic pirate active in the Fawn Star System. He was a Grade B Super and belonged to the infamous galactic pirate organization, the Purple Snake Galactic Pirate Gang.

The Purple Snake Galactic Pirate Gang had dozens of plundering spaceships, and their captain was a Calamity Grade Super. The Black Raven Civilization had put a bounty of 2,800,000 Enas on him. Han Xiao had once been stuck on the Promotion Mission of killing a Grade Super, and the captain of the Purple Snake Galactic Pirate Gang was one of the targets he had considered. Later on, he had drawn a Mission Completion Card, so he did not take the risk.

More than two years ago, Han Xiao had brought Mad Blade and the other players to do missions, and they had once killed an officer of the Purple Snake Galactic Pirate Gang. At that time, they had formed a grudge. As a mercenary, it was inevitable to have enemies, and Han Xiao had long been used to it.

Befuli was an officer of the Purple Snake Galactic Pirate Gang. He led a team and came to the Garton Star System to plunder while Godora was facing both external and internal problems. At this time, the team he led was hiding their identities and resting in Juberly Hub. In the past, they had mainly been active in the Fawn Star System, so it was easy to disguise themselves in the Garton Star System.

"Enemy? Who?! "

"It's Black Star!"

"So, it's him." Befuli laughed with a sinister expression. "A few years ago, he killed Mado's team in the Fawn Star System. Heh, although I don't like Mado, this debt is something that the captain has always remembered."

"Boss, Black Star is only one person. Should we make a move on him?"

A galactic pirate asked softly with a murderous look in his eyes.

Befuli heard this and laughed boorishly. "Hahaha, do you think that Black Star is so easy to kill? Are you courting death?! "

As he spoke, Befuli's face suddenly changed. He grabbed his subordinate's neck and pulled him to his eyes. He said in a ferocious voice, "Brat, you don't have the qualifications to covet someone of that level. You better respect the strong!"

This galactic pirate swallowed a mouthful of saliva nervously and nodded. Boss Befuli's temper was unpredictable, and he did not dare to anger him.

Befuli let go of his hand, grabbed the wine glass, and finished the rest of the liquor in one gulp. He wiped his mouth, stood up, and walked toward the door with large strides.

"Little ones, follow me."

The few galactic pirates behind him hurriedly followed behind Befuli and asked carefully, "Boss, what are we going to do now?"
